mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as 3-month change) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicate a broad-based demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% over past 3 months), higher discount rates suppress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 over the past month signals manufacturing sector contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) compresses equity risk premiums, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 140,000 thousand over the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS falls below 140,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL rising above 235.0 over past month) triggers monetary policy concerns, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
